newsitem.title: USA: Applied Graphics acquires MBA Graphics.
newsitem.headline: Applied Graphics acquires MBA Graphics.

text.p: Applied Graphics Technologies Inc said Tuesday it had acquired MBA Graphics Inc, a commercial graphic and digital prepress imaging firm serving the retailing, manufacturing and publishing industries.
Terms of the deal were undisclosed.
MBA Graphics' largest customer is Home Depot, Applied Graphics said. MBA's 1996 revenues were about $5.5 million.

Applied Graphics said the company would operate as a stand-alone division specializing in retail customers. It said the company's management team would remain and that it plans no layoffs from the deal.
Applied Graphics, which provides outsourced advanced digital image-management and archiving services, had 1996 revenues of more than $130 million.
